Fifteen New York sheriffs filed a federal lawsuit challenging the newly enacted Local Cops, Local Crimes Act, which bars local cooperation with ICE on civil immigration matters.

Judicial review provides a constitutional forum to clarify jurisdictional boundaries between state and federal authority.

Confusing WHAT (local crime enforcement) with WHO (federal immigration jurisdiction).

It is a structural jurisdictional turf war framed as constitutional principle.

By imposing top-down mandates rather than building collaborative local frameworks, state leaders escalate friction. Both sides use legal battles as pretexts to project blame.

The Unavoidable Truth: Local law enforcement faces conflicting constitutional and federal mandates.

The Unavoidable Lie: This legal battle is purely about protecting local communities.
